svg.text: ELEGOO 170-point • 17 numbered rows shown vertically × a–j • center channel separates each row
Each colored marker is an occupied hole; resistors bridge e → f in numbered rows 9, 11 and 13.
Within each numbered row, a–e are connected together; f–j are connected together. The center gap isolates the halves.
Use a 220 Ω resistor in each of numbered rows 9, 11 and 13. Resistors have no polarity; keep their leads in separate holes.
Six button leads go to a3, a5, a7, a9, a11, a13. Six Pi jumpers go to c3, c5, c7, h9, h11, h13.
Color identifies function, not the unknown color of the button’s pre-wired leads. Identify leads on the button first.
Pin 11 uses the Pi internal pull-up; press = LOW. RGB cathodes are active LOW.
